uzo.purpose: Takes one line of text from a person: a name, an address, an e-mail, a number, a time, a search term.

instead.kialo: Several lines need a growing field, because one line hides them.
Many options are a list, because a field takes any text; elektilo covers it.
A few options are picked, not typed, because typing errs; elekto covers it.
A setting on or off shows its state, because a text must be read to know it; sxaltilo when it applies at once (in a form, applied with it: markobutono).
Suggestions are picked while typing, because the list shortens.
A value set by feel is dragged, because a hand finds it faster.
A value changes in place, because a form for one value is a detour.

boundary.kialo: A switch that shows the password is a control of its own, because the field only hides; a person decides whether a product wants it.
A fraction is written with a comma or a point, because the separator is a locale; number takes whole numbers only.
Two dates that depend on each other are the datelektilo's, because the end lies after the start and a calendar shows both at once (Spec 025 ② closes the boundary date-range).
A time zone or a period (am, pm) beside the time is a choice of its own, because the platform's time input takes the time in the person's own clock; a person decides whether a product wants it.
A file is chosen, not typed, because the value is not text; the alsxutilo chooses files and states which are allowed (Spec 015 ② closes the boundary file).
A field without a visible label is lost once typing starts, because the placeholder disappears then.
A prefix or suffix (currency, unit, icon) comes in a later round, because it changes the inline room; until then an icon stands next to the field.

containers.name: form
containers.kialo: A field without a form has no sender, because the entry is only sent with the form.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A dialog may demand an entry before it ends, because the decision it ends in may need a value.

containers.name: search-bar
containers.kialo: A search is one field with its button, because the term is the whole entry.

with.kialo: Fields of one form stand stacked, because a person reads a form top down and fills it in that order.
The form ends with the button that sends it, because filling it in does nothing by itself; the button stands after the last field, not beside it (a search excepted).
A kampo of kind number stands beside the track of a glitilo with input, because a value one drags is also a value one may type and read exactly.
A kampo of kind date stands beside a datelektilo only for a date far away, because a birthday is typed faster than scrolled; a date near today and a date range are the datelektilo's.

never.kialo: A field stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name and the field could not be reached on its own.

case.de: Der Text läuft über mehrere Zeilen.
case.en: The text runs over several lines.

case.de: Die Antwort ist eine von wenigen festen Optionen.
case.en: The answer is one of a few fixed options.

case.de: Beim Tippen sollen passende Vorschläge erscheinen.
case.en: Matching suggestions are to appear while typing.

case.de: Gefragt ist ein Datum nahe heute oder ein Zeitraum mit Anfang und Ende.
case.en: A date near today or a range with a start and an end is asked for.

case.de: Der Wert ist eine Datei vom Gerät.
case.en: The value is a file from the device.

do.de: Lass die sichtbare Beschriftung die Angabe nennen, die gefragt ist.
do.en: Let the visible label name the datum asked for.

do.de: Wähle kind passend zum Inhalt, damit Tastatur und Hilfen auf Touch-Geräten stimmen.
do.en: Choose kind to suit the content, so the keyboard and the aids on touch devices fit.

do.de: Nenne bei einer Zahl die Einheit mit unit und die Grenzen mit min und max.
do.en: Give a number its unit with unit and its bounds with min and max.

dont.de: Den Platzhalter als Beschriftung nutzen, denn er verschwindet beim Tippen.
dont.en: Use the placeholder as the label, because it disappears while typing.

dont.de: Eine Zahl mit Komma in kind number erwarten, denn number nimmt nur ganze Zahlen.
dont.en: Expect a number with a decimal separator in kind number, because number takes whole numbers only.

dont.de: Eine Einheit, Schrittknöpfe oder einen Schritt (unit, stepper, step) bei einer anderen Art als number setzen.
dont.en: Set a unit, step buttons or a step (unit, stepper, step) with a kind other than number.

action.de: Sendet das Formular, in dem das Feld steht.
action.en: Sends the form the field stands in.

action.de: Erhöht oder senkt bei kind number den Wert um einen Schritt.
action.en: Raises or lowers the value by one step with kind number.

action.de: Leert bei kind search den getippten Text.
action.en: Empties the typed text with kind search.
